findings_and_questions.source_observation: JunctionBond is publicly constructible and derives Deserialize with raw f32 minimum_interface_area_square_metres and maximum_penetration_metres. The wall-corner producer retains a product of extents and a maximum penetration expression directly. BondedInterfaceMetrics checks measured area in Area and then compares its extracted square metres plus 0.005 tolerance to the raw minimum; penetration is compared to the raw maximum plus tolerance.
findings_and_questions.conditional_case: For a directly constructed bond whose minimum is a finite negative value, the area threshold conjunct is always true for any finite nonnegative measured Area; other bounds and penetration conjuncts still apply. If supported extent inputs allow f32 multiplication overflow, the producer can retain an infinite minimum; admitted-plan bounds and native deserializer format support remain unproved. These are source and mathematical implications, not an executed example.
findings_and_questions.first_contract: Any intended finite nonnegative bond threshold must be admitted at its retained owner and kept through producers before the audit compares it; geometric contact correctness is separate from the threshold admission.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Area and SignedLength remain typed through individual checked construction and retained metrics; JunctionBond threshold producer stores raw f32, and fits later compares it without this leaf admission.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Current fabelgeist-geometry exports SignedLength, PositiveLength and Area; Area can express nonnegative square-metre values if the bond minimum contract agrees. SignedLength accepts negative offsets and alone cannot impose a nonnegative penetration cap.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Private scalar fields; from_metres and from_square_metres gate nonfinite, Area additionally rejects negative and accepts zero; both manual Deserialize call their constructors. Reflect paths and all downstream construction remain outside this body.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Signed min/max on finite leaves remain finite, u16 millimetres conversion is bounded, and scaled_by readmits product; negative zero is numerically nonnegative and preserved, without asserting a sign-bit policy.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: CuboidDimensions::from_axis_lengths checks nonnegative extent after SignedLength admission, demonstrating a narrower aggregate contract. JunctionBond threshold policy and any whole-plan validation remain open.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Canonical fabelgeist-geometry reexports scalar owners; building-generator spatial_geometry reexports them. Same unit does not prove all geometry meanings interchangeable or that unrelated owners duplicate.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: The measured contact Area and bond minimum are a measurement and threshold rather than automatic duplicate authorities. The connected raw threshold and measured formula remain separate contract questions.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Current source differs from P17 only import formatting; preserve accepted signed negatives, zero area, u16 conversion operation order, and independently retained tolerated gap behavior in any future repair.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: No semantic boolean/neighboring payload owner in assigned scalar file; aggregate callers require separate review, so no whole-lens clearance is claimed.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Serialize on the admitted representation and manual Deserialize enforce checked admission; deriving Deserialize blindly could bypass it. Opaque Reflect is declared but native macro/runtime semantics are not independently established.
thirteen_lenses.type-granularity: PositiveLength, SignedLength, and Area embody distinct sign and unit sets; squared-distance use in bell swing is unit-compatible with the documented Area leaf, without proving a broader semantic owner decision.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Assigned file has documentation and diagnostic conversion to Serde custom errors, not a discovered private runtime string protocol. Wire formats and all diagnostic consumers remain out of scope.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: 1,000.0 is the millimetre-to-metre conversion in a local numerical kernel and u16 establishes finiteness; 0.005 area and 0.025 distance tolerances are consumer policies, not evidence to replace blindly.
